collection.title: Audi SQ8 2020 to 2025 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a the Audi SQ8 2020 Onwards which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this SQ8 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
